test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

some balls bounce.

All balls vibrate.

**Conclusion:**

I. Even the balls that do not bounce, vibrate.

II. The balls that do not bounce, do not necessarily vibrate.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
According to the statements, we have the Venn diagram:

Statement 1: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61b0356811fb84f2e163acb26ecd00a7169754d59b7ee503aecb7a308fbdb7c8.png] 

Statement 2: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/299c5abf8183d04aa45a6409bd590edc520c41cdbdf1bb41cbfddab6442cf60d.png] 

Thus, by combining the statements, we will get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de17153fffd2717c14d6455d3e56828c7ca3886152a03ec93b65de50b73e95e6.png] 

Next, we will check the conclusions:

I. Even the balls that do not bounce, vibrate: Since all balls vibrate, some balls will vibrate. This is true.

II. The balls that do not bounce do not necessarily vibrate: All balls vibrate because balls are the subset of vibrate, so whether the ball bounces or does not bounce, the ball will vibrate. This is not true.

Thus, only '**conclusion I**' is true.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
